parameters.content:
## IP Intelligence — Combined System
One workflow, three entrances: Operator console, Investigation portal, Queue schedule.

Console action: demo (default), setup, ops, maintenance, enable. Set action in Console action, then execute Operator console.

Run setup to produce Supabase SQL. Set the project URL once in System configuration. Attach one shared Supabase backend credential to RPC nodes. Add the three provider credentials in Enrich queued IP. Use enable to configure one provider at a time using enable - Provider choice.

Portal actions: submit (IP and reason), report (case_id), case (case_id, status, owner and note).

Supabase budgets, leases, caching, deduplication, retries and audit history are preserved. Credentials stay in n8n credentials, never input fields. All providers start disabled. Configure form access before exposing the portal. Live SQL/concurrency tests require credentials.

The earlier separate workflows are reference drafts; this combined workflow runs independently and does not call them.
